SPECIMEN CALCULATION OF DUSTFALL POTENTIAL (ref - Table 10)
400 Structures in 90 Days - No Control
Rate of dust generation - lbs/working day
376,000 lbs/90 days = 4178 lbs/day
940 lbs/structure x 400 structures = 370,000 lbs
Dustfall potential:
Assume 22 working days per month:
4178 lbs/day x 22 days = 91,916 lbs = 45.95 tons
Assume Boston area = 43.5 sq mi
\frac{45.95 \text{ tons}}{43.5 \text{ sq mi}} = 1.06 \text{ tons/sq mi/month}
Assume a value of 45 tons/sq mi/month
Percentage increase = 
\frac{1.06}{45}
 = 2.4%
